packages.reason: All four nodes — ערלה (the impurity husk encircling the covenant), חרפה (shame/disgrace), רעב (hunger/famine), and מחלקת (strife/conflict) — are declared by the Rebbe to be bechinas of one another in a single chain: 'וְרָעָב הַזֶּה, הַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת מַחֲלֹקֶת, בְּחִינַת חֶרְפָּה, הוּא בְּחִינַת עָרְלָה' (source line 6). They are four faces of the same essential reality: the anti-shalom force that blocks the ברית שלום (covenant of peace) and produces spiritual and physical lack. The two raw bechina edges from the dataset (ערלה–חרפה and רעב–מחלקת) form 2 separate components of 2 nodes each only because the cross-linking edges (e.g. מחלקת–חרפה and רעב–ערלה, also explicitly stated in the same proof text) have not yet been entered into the dataset. The text equates all four in one continuous bechina statement, making this a single coherent domain: the multi-form evil that surrounds and suppresses the covenant.
